name: Scarto
description: Scarto is a Piedmontese tarot trick-taking game from northwestern Italy. It is played with the full 78-card Tarocco Piemontese family and emphasizes careful discard, trump timing, and partnership coordination over multiple deals.

overview.description: Scarto is a Piedmontese tarot trick-taking game from northwestern Italy. It is played with the full 78-card Tarocco Piemontese family and emphasizes careful discard, trump timing, and partnership coordination over multiple deals.

history.origins: Scarto belongs to the northern Italian tarocchi tradition and is associated with Piedmontese tarot practice.
timeline: 18th-19th century: Tarocco games spread across Piedmont.
Modern era: Scarto remains documented in tarot game references.
history.cultural: Scarto is part of the regional Italian tarot family where local table customs shape partnership signaling and tempo.
history.evolution: The game keeps the broader tarocchi structure while centering tactical discard and trick control.

setup.players: Four players in fixed partnerships, partners seated opposite.
setup.deck: A full 78-card Tarocco Piemontese deck with trumps, fool, and four Italian-suited series.
setup.dealing: Cards are dealt to all players and play proceeds by tricks according to local tarocchi order and obligations.
setup.equipment: Tarocco Piemontese deck and score tracking.

rules.objective: Win tricks and card points through correct suit following, trump use, and partnership planning.
rules.gameplay: Players follow suit when possible; if unable, they play a trump when required by table rules, otherwise discard. Highest trump wins a trumped trick, otherwise highest card in the led suit wins. Trick winners lead next.
keyRules: Follow-suit obligations apply before discard freedom.
Trump management determines control of late tricks.
Point cards and final trick outcomes shape the result.

strategy.basic: Preserve key trumps and avoid spending control cards too early.
strategy.intermediate: Track played trumps and use discard windows to protect high-value cards.
strategy.advanced: Coordinate with partner around tempo, entry control, and point-carrying tricks while planning endgame trump pressure.
tips: Plan your discard choices around future suit control.
Do not waste high trumps before critical scoring tricks.

scoring.winCondition: Team with the higher valid score after the agreed number of deals wins.
